title: Identity-open cancellation for the system proper projection
statement: Fix D,C,E and realized coefficient-system operations o,z as in [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data], with openIdentity of [def-sf-integral-proper-projection-coordinates]. Let f:X→Y be a proper morphism of schemes and let M,N be arbitrary derived coefficient systems on X,Y. Tensor of system direct image of openIdentity at M and identity N, followed by the system proper projection at M,N, equals the identity-open compactification projection at M,N followed by system direct image of openIdentity at tensor(M,pull_f N). This statement involves no integral object, integral operation datum, or finite evaluation.

proof.text: Use the section-normalized identity-pair pullback unit to choose e:P_id≅Id. Its adjoint-conjugate equation identifies e with the canonical bridge followed by the semilinear pId. Uniqueness of left adjoints then identifies leftAdjointIdIso of the open adjunction and e with the specified openIdentity.

proof.text: Apply tensor-composition compatibility to the identity pair. After normalization by e, faithfulness of P_id and cancellation of the invertible tensor comparison force its identity tensor equation. Apply compositor associativity to id,id,f and use the identity-pair unit to prove that inverse c.pullComp(id,f), followed by equality transport, is e at P_f N.

proof.text: Transpose the inverse open projection. Its defining transpose is tensor of the open unit and identity followed by inverse tensor comparison. The identity tensor equation and the unit equation for leftAdjointIdIso identify this with tensor of inverse openIdentity and e. Cancel the inverse projection to obtain the identity-open projection equation.

proof.text: First-variable naturality of the proper projection moves push(openIdentity) through it. Expand the identity-open compactification projection and substitute the inverse-compositor unit equation. Apply proper direct image to the open projection equation, using functoriality and associativity, to finish.

lean.statement:
theorem systemProperIdentityOpenProjection
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (M : System C.l E X) (N : System C.l E Y) :
    (calculus C.l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((Operations.push C.l E o f).map
          ((openIdentity o z X).hom.app M)) (𝟙 N)) ≫
        ((properProjection C.l E o f).app M).app N =
      compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons
          (.ofIsProper f) M N ≫
        (Operations.push C.l E o f).map ((openIdentity o z X).hom.app
          ((calculus C.l E X).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, (pull C.l E f).obj N)))
